exposure: mothers' having received advice on EBF
disclosure of HIV status to someone close
believing HIV can be transmitted during delivery
outcome: exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) practices in the first six months
cohort: The study included 218 HIV-positive mothers with infants aged 6-23 months, attending public health facilities in Western Ethiopia.
finding: Receiving advice on EBF, disclosing HIV status, and believing in HIV transmission during delivery significantly increased the likelihood of exclusive breastfeeding among HIV-positive mothers.
